info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Refund Cancellation API
info.description: The Refund Cancellation API enables businesses to efficiently manage and cancel pending refunds associated with transactions. This API primarily interacts with refund resources, allowing users to update the status of specific refunds identified by their unique refundId. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial services seeking to enhance their customer service capabilities. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can ensure streamlined processes for handling customer inquiries regarding refund statuses.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a refund request identified by a unique reservation code. It is essential for managing refund processes and ensuring that users can retract refund requests when necessary.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a specific refund identified by its unique reference number, RES-100045. It must follow the specified schema and contain all required fields to successfully initiate the cancellation process.
